description.value: Fields is a Canadian-owned rural general store chain that has served highway-bound travellers and remote communities across Western Canada since 1948. This location carries everyday essentials including basic groceries, clothing, and household goods — a useful resupply stop in an area where options are limited. The familiar red-lettered storefront is a landmark for road-trippers passing through small BC communities.
